blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Precisely reproducing a target span verbatim within a long context is a fundamental capability test for LLMs: even when the target string is present in context, models often still drift within the span or fail to stop correctly, revealing limitations in source grounding and boundary control. This capability has broad practical relevance. For instance, code generation often requires embedding sensitive strings such as API keys exactly as they appear in context. In this work, we construct a benchmark to test exact span reproduction ability across contracts, scientific literature, code, and random sequences, and find that current models still make surprisingly frequent errors. To address this, we propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying from a byproduct of next-token prediction into a controlled process. Our key idea is to decompose copying into three distinct decisions: when to copy, how far to copy, and when to stop. Concretely, CopyGen first determines whether to enter copy mode, then predicts a tentative copy length, and finally verifies the generated span token by token. During verification, we adaptively adjust the logits of copy continuation tokens to incentivize or suppress continuation, and emit only the longest valid prefix. Across three LLM backbones and four benchmark tasks, CopyGen improves average exact match by 35% relative without model finetuning, and integrates seamlessly with SFT to further improve it by 4%, while substantially accelerating generation. These results suggest that reliable exact copying is not something LLMs obtain for free, but a decoding-time control problem that requires explicit modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CopyGen.
blocks.zh: 精确地在长的语境中复制一个横跨目标是一个对LLMS的基本能力测试:即使目标字符串在语境中存在,模型仍然常常在横跨范围内漂移,或者无法正确停止,揭示出源头搁浅和边界控制方面的局限性. 这一能力具有广泛的实际意义。 例如,代码生成往往要求嵌入敏感字符串,如API密钥与上下文中出现的完全相同. 在这部作品中,我们构建了一个基准,测试跨合同、科学文献、代码和随机序列的精确复制能力,并发现目前的模型仍然出乎意料地经常出错。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议CopyGen, 一个轻量级的复制限制插件, 用于冷冻的LLMs, 将复制从下一个预测的副产品变成一个可控的过程。 我们的关键想法是把复制品分解成三个不同的决定:何时复制,何时复制,何时停止。 具体来说,CopyGen首先确定是否输入复制模式,然后预测一个暂定复制长度,最后通过符号验证生成的跨度符号. 在核查过程中,我们适应性地调整复制续作符号的对数,以激励或压制续作,只发出最长的有效前缀. 在三个LLM主干线和四个基准任务中,CopyGen改进了平均精确匹配率35%的相对,而没有模型微调,并与SFT无缝整合,以进一步提升4%,同时大幅加速生成. 这些结果表明,可靠的准确复制并不是LLMs免费获得的东西,而是一个解码时间控制问题,需要明确的模型. 代码见https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CopyGen.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Precisely reproducing long spans of text verbatim, referred to as instruction-conditioned long-span exact copying, can be used to evaluate large language models’ ability in exact copying and controlled generation.
Although it appears simple, this task places nontrivial demands on models’ capabilities in sequence alignment, boundary identification, and fine-grained control over generation. At the same time, this capability has important practical value.
In software engineering workflows, models must preserve API keys, identifiers, or configuration strings exactly as they appear in context [ 11 ] . In legal processing, they must reproduce clauses verbatim rather than paraphrase them [ 26 ] .
In such settings, a single incorrect character can break execution or alter the meaning of a legally sensitive passage. Furthermore, when the desired span is already present in the input, regenerating it token by token is both error-prone and computationally unnecessary, making exact copying not only a practically important capability but also an opportunity for improved efficiency.
blocks.zh:
确切地复制了长长的文字逐字记录,称为有指导条件的长相复制,可用来评价大语文模型准确复制和控制生成的能力。
尽管看起来很简单,但这一任务对模型在序列调整、边界识别和精细控制生成方面的能力提出了非三角要求。 与此同时,这种能力具有重要的实际价值。
在软件工程工作流程中,模型必须保留与上下文[11]中出现的完全相同的API密钥,标识符,或配置字符串. 在法律处理中,它们必须逐字转载条款,而不必加以解释。
在这种环境下,一个单一的不正确的字符可以中断执行或改变法律上敏感的通道的含义. 此外,如果在输入中已经出现所期望的跨度,以象征性方式重新生成象征值既容易出错,也没有必要进行计算,使准确复制不仅成为实际重要的能力,而且也是提高效率的机会。

blocks.en:
Despite its practical importance, long-span exact copying has not been studied as a capability in its own right.
Existing work on copying falls into two lines, neither of which addresses this problem directly.
Architectural copy mechanisms such as CopyNet [ 8 ] and pointer-generator networks [ 25 ] help models reuse source tokens to improve generation quality, but do not target character-level exactness.
Efficiency-oriented methods such as speculative decoding [ 13 ] , LLMA [ 28 ] , and CopySpec [ 6 ] accelerate inference through multi-token proposal or reuse, with correctness verified against the base model’s own predictions rather than strengthened by the copy process itself.
blocks.zh:
尽管它具有实际重要性,但长期准确的复制本身没有作为能力来研究.
现有的复制工作分为两行,两行都没有直接解决这一问题。
CopyNet [8]和指针-生成器网络等建筑复制机制[25]帮助模型再利用源令牌提高生成质量,但并不瞄准字符级精确度.
以效率为导向的方法,如投机解码[13],LLMA[28],和CopySpec[6]通过多键建议或再利用来加速推论,其正确性与基准模型本身的预测相仿,而不是被复制过程本身所强化.

blocks.en:
To make this problem concrete, we construct a benchmark for instruction-conditioned exact span reproduction that focuses on preserving the required source text verbatim during generation, rather than broader questions of semantic faithfulness.
Specifically, the benchmark covers three real-world tasks, namely legal contracts, scientific literature, and code contexts, where even minor deviations are unacceptable.
We further include a synthetic random-sequence task to stress-test copying performance under extreme conditions.
Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of LLMs and find that standard decoding fails consistently across model families and sizes.
The errors mainly take two characteristic forms.
Internal token mismatches arise when the model drifts mid-span, substituting a plausible-but-wrong token for the correct one.
Boundary overruns occur when the model continues generating along the source span even after the target span should have ended.
These failures suggest that exact copying requires stronger control than standard next-token prediction provides, calling for an explicit copying mechanism that can maintain source alignment and enforce the correct stopping boundary.
blocks.zh:
为了使这一问题具体化,我们为附有指导条件的准确复制工作设计了一个基准,重点是在一代人期间保留必要的原始文本,而不是广义的语义忠诚问题。
具体地说,该基准涵盖三个现实世界的任务,即法律合同、科学文献和守则背景,即使轻微偏离也是不可接受的。
我们还包括一项合成随机序列的任务,在极端条件下测试压力复制性能.
使用这一基准,我们评估了一系列有限责任公司,发现标准解码在模范家庭和规模上始终失败。
错误主要有两种特征形式.
当模型飘出中流层时,内部的标志不匹配就出现,用一个可能但错误的标志来代替正确的标志.
当该模型在源地一带继续生成,甚至在目标跨度本应终止之后,即发生边界超标。
这些失败表明,准确的复制需要比标准下接键预测提供的更强的控制,要求有一个明确的复制机制来维持源对齐,并强制执行正确的停止边界.

blocks.en:
To tackle this issue, we propose CopyGen , a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs.
The key idea is to treat exact copying as a controlled decoding problem rather than a byproduct of next-token prediction.
CopyGen decomposes exact copying into three coupled decisions: when to copy, how far to tentatively copy, and when to stop.
Concretely, at each decoding step, CopyGen measures how strongly the current output prefix is anchored to the source. Once sufficient grounding is detected, the plugin proposes a tentative copy span and replays it token by token against the frozen model.
Our analysis reveals tokens that should be copied are predicted with a large logits margin over competing alternatives, while errors, whether mid-span drifts or boundary overruns, concentrate precisely where that margin narrows.
During verification, we utilize a learned bias to calibrate the margin at each replayed position, reinforcing source-following where confidence is high and suppressing it where the boundary is near, emitting only the longest prefix that clears the threshold.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们提议 CopyGen, 一个轻量级的复制限制插件,用于冷冻LLMS.
关键的想法是将准确的复制视为一个可控的解码问题,而不是相邻的预测的副产品.
CopyGen将精确地复制成三个并发的决定:何时复制,何时暂时复制,何时停止.
具体地说,CopyGen在每个解码步骤上,都测量当前输出前缀对源的锚定程度. 一旦检测到足够的地平面,插件会提出一个暂定拷贝跨度,并对照被冻结的模型逐个地标重放.
我们的分析显示,应该复制的符号用很大的对数比相竞的替代品差幅来预测,而错误,无论是中流或边界被突破,都集中在差幅缩小的地方。
在核查期间,我们利用所学到的偏差来校正每个重放位置的比值,在信任度高的地方加强源跟随,在边界相近的地方加以压制,只释放出清除门槛的最长前缀.

blocks.en: Across three LLM backbones and four benchmark tasks, CopyGen delivers substantial improvements in both copy accuracy and decoding efficiency. When applied to frozen models, it improves average exact match by approximately 35% relative. When combined with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), CopyGen continues to provide gains, further increasing average exact match by about 4% relative while also significantly improving decoding throughput. These results suggest that reliable exact copying is not an emergent byproduct of LLM training, but rather a capability that requires explicit control at decoding time along with dedicated copying mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 在整个三个LLM主干线和四个基准任务中,CopyGen在复制精度和解码效率两方面都有了很大的改进. 在被应用到被冷冻的模型中时,平均精确匹配率会提高约35%的相对. CopyGen与有监督的微调(SFT)相结合,继续提供收益,使平均精确匹配率进一步提高了大约4%的相对量,同时也大大提高了编码吞吐量。 这些结果表明,可靠的准确复制不是LLM培训的副产品,而是在解码时需要明确控制的能力,以及专门的复制机制。

blocks.en:
In summary, our contributions are threefold:
(1) We formulate instruction-conditioned long-span exact copying as a distinct evaluation problem and introduce a dedicated benchmark for studying it.
(2) We propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that augments frozen LLMs with explicit copy control during decoding.
(3) We demonstrate that CopyGen substantially improves exact-copy reliability and decoding throughput across model families and scales, and remains effective when combined with supervised finetuning.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们的贡献有三:
(1) 我们制定附有指导条件的长字形精确复制,作为一个独特的评价问题,并采用专门基准来研究这个问题。
(2)我们提出CopyGen,一个为被冻结的LLMs提供轻量级拷贝受限插件,在解码时能用明确的拷贝控制来增强被冻结的LLMs.
(3) 我们证明,CopyGen大大改进了整个模范家庭和尺度的准确复制可靠性和编码吞吐量,如果结合有监督的微调,则依然有效。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Grounded and Faithful Generation. A closely related line of work studies how to make model outputs stay faithful to an external source rather than drifting toward unsupported continuations.
This includes constrained generation frameworks for truthful dialogue grounded in symbolic representations [ 7 ] , methods for verifiable generation with fine-grained citations to supporting documents [ 2 ] , and approaches that improve context adherence by adapting the model or prompt at inference time [ 31 ] .
In retrieval-augmented settings, faithfulness has also been studied as the problem of making generation follow retrieved evidence, especially when retrieved context conflicts with the model’s parametric knowledge [ 29 ] .
These works constrain generation to respect an external source, but target semantic faithfulness rather than character-level exactness. Our setting is stricter: even a single character error or formatting corruption already constitutes failure.
blocks.zh:
守地而忠义一代. 一个密切相关的工作领域研究如何使模型产出忠于外部来源,而不是向无支持的延续方向飘去。
这包括基于象征性表述的有限生成对话框架[7];可核查生成方法,对辅助文件进行精细引用[2];通过调整模型或及时推论[31]改进上下文一致性的方法。
在检索增强的设置中,还研究了忠诚问题,因为使生成遵循检索证据的问题,特别是当检索到的背景与模型的参数化知识相冲突时[29]。
这些作品制约了一代人尊重外源,但目标语义上的忠实,而不是人物级的精确. 我们的设置更加严格:即使是一个字符错误或格式化的腐败也已经构成失败。

blocks.en:
Constrained and Controlled Decoding. Constrained Decoding aims to control model behavior directly at inference time instead of modifying the full model.
Early methods were primarily designed to enforce formal validity, for example by restricting generation to syntactically admissible outputs, as in PICARD [ 24 ] for text-to-SQL decoding.
More recent approaches have extended this idea beyond syntax to broader inference-time control, including symbolic or grammar-based constraints in grounded generation [ 7 , 22 ] , relation-level constraints [ 3 ] , energy-based constrained generation [ 23 ] , and efficient non-invasive constraint enforcement [ 1 ] .
CopyGen is similarly a decoding-time intervention, but differs in the type of constraint it imposes.
It is a source-grounded copy constraint that evolves online with the generated prefix, requiring decisions not only on whether to copy, but also how far to extend and where to stop.
blocks.zh:
约束和控制了解码。 约束解码的目的是在推断时间直接控制模型行为,而不是修改完整的模型.
早期的方法主要是为了加强形式上的有效性,例如,将生成限制在可实际接受产出方面,如PICARD[24]中关于文本到SQL解码的规定。
较新的方法将这一想法从语法扩大到更广泛的推论时间控制,包括基于底代的象征性或语法限制[7,22],关系层面的限制[3],基于能的受限生成[23],以及有效的非侵入性约束执行[1].
CopyGen同样是解码时间的介入,但其施加的制约类型不同.
这是一个基于源的复制限制,随着生成的前缀在线演化而来,不仅需要决定是否复制,而且需要决定扩展多远和在哪里停止.

blocks.en:
Copying and Exact Reproduction in Language Models. Copy mechanism has a long history in sequence generation.
Early neural models introduced explicit copy distributions or pointer mechanisms to reproduce source tokens [ 8 , 25 ] , and later extended them to more explicit span-level copying and alignment [ 21 ] .
More recent inference-time methods also reuse source spans during decoding, primarily to accelerate generation [ 28 , 6 ] or improve generation quality [ 14 , 15 ] , rather than to ensure exact reproduction itself.
A separate thread studies copying as emergent or potentially risky behavior, including controlling memorized content extraction [ 20 ] , studying probabilistic extraction of memorized content [ 9 ] , and analyzing copying as a pretraining ability [ 17 ] .
Our work differs from all of these: we focus on instruction-conditioned exact reproduction of spans explicitly present in the current context, and pair this with a dedicated benchmark and a decoding mechanism designed to improve exact-copy reliability.
blocks.zh:
在语言模型中复制和精确复制. 复制机制在序列生成上有很长的历史.
早期的神经模型引入了清晰的复制发行或指针机制来复制源令牌[8,25],后被扩展为更清晰的跨级复制和对接[21].
更近期的推论-时间方法在解码过程中也跨出再利用源,主要是为了加速生成[28,6]或提高生成质量[14,15],而不是确保准确的复制本身.
一份单独的线程研究将复制作为突发或潜在风险行为,包括控制记忆内容提取[20],研究对记忆内容的概率提取[9],分析复制作为预训能力[17].
我们的工作与所有这些不同:我们侧重于以指导条件准确复制当前背景下明确存在的跨度,并配以专用基准和编码机制,以提高准确的复制可靠性。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We consider instruction-conditioned exact copying from long source documents. Each example is a triple ( x 1 : M , r , y 1 : T ) (x_{1:M},r,y_{1:T}) , where x 1 : M x_{1:M} is a source document, r r is a user instruction, and y 1 : T y_{1:T} is the target output, all represented in the token space of a frozen base LM with vocabulary 𝒱 \mathcal{V} .
The target y 1 : T y_{1:T} consists of two interleaved components: spans copied verbatim from the source, and novel tokens not present in the source.
Our goal is to recover y 1 : T y_{1:T} exactly: for copied spans, every character, boundary, and formatting detail must be preserved; for novel tokens, generation should proceed faithfully as usual.
Our preliminary experiments show that standard autoregressive decoding is brittle for copy-heavy outputs: small local mistakes can truncate a copied span, omit formatting, or continue beyond the correct boundary.
We therefore propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained method for frozen LLMs that governs three decisions: when to start copying (§ 3.1 ), how far to propose copying (§ 3.2 ), and how much of the proposal to verify and emit (§ 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Copy Triggering
blocks.zh: 3.1 复制触发

blocks.en: Reliable copying requires knowing precisely when to start. Entering copy mode too early risks producing spurious repetitions, while entering too late causes the model to miss the correct span entirely. We therefore design a two-stage trigger: first measuring how strongly the current prefix is anchored to the source, then using a learned head to make the final decision.
blocks.zh: 可靠的复制需要准确知道何时开始。 输入复制模式太早可能会产生虚假的重复,而输入太晚则会使模型完全错失正确的跨度. 因此,我们设计出一个分两个阶段的触发器:首先测量当前前缀被锚定在源头的强度,再用一个有学识的头来作出最后的决定.

blocks.en:
Once copy mode is activated, the model must decide how far to follow the current source continuation.
A fixed copy length is too rigid for this purpose.
If it is too small, copying must be repeated over many rounds, increasing both overhead and creating more opportunities for transition errors.
If it is too large, the proposal is more likely to cross the correct boundary, making verification harder and increasing the risk of over-copy.
Recognizing that a fixed copy length is suboptimal, we instead predict a tentative copy length adaptively from the current state and leave the final decision to the verifier, which can still truncate the proposal if necessary.
To make this prediction stable under the highly skewed distribution of copy lengths, we predict length in log space.

Given a proposed source span, the verifier’s role is to determine how much of it can be safely emitted.
To inform this decision, we conduct an empirical analysis on output token logits during decoding, as shown in Figure 2 .
For a candidate source token x j x_{j} and the frozen model’s next-token logit vector o o , we define the source margin as Δ = o ⁡ [ x j ] − max v ∈ 𝒱 , v ≠ x j ⁡ o ⁡ [ v ] \Delta=o[x_{j}]-\max_{v\in\mathcal{V},\,v\neq x_{j}}o[v] ,
i.e., the gap between the source-token logit and the strongest alternative-token logit.
A key observation is that most correctly copied tokens are preferred by a large margin, so these decisions are highly confident and far from the boundary.
By contrast, copy errors concentrate near the decision boundary.
Internal mismatches typically occur when the correct source token falls slightly below the strongest competing token.
Overrun errors, in contrast, often occur when the next source token remains only slightly above the strongest alternative, even though generation should have left the copied span.
This pattern suggests that the verifier should not replace the base model’s preference altogether, but should apply a small adaptive correction precisely in these boundary cases.
We implement this through margin calibration, prefix acceptance, and a boundary-focused training objective.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Benchmark Details. We evaluate exact span reproduction on three real-world domains: Contract , Literature , and Code .
Across all three domains, the target spans are highly sensitive to boundaries, formatting, and character-level corruption, so even small deviations can make the output unusable.
blocks.zh:
基准细节。 我们评估了三个现实世界的复制范围:契约、文学和法典。
在所有三个领域,目标跨度对边界,格式化,和字符级腐败高度敏感,因此即使是小偏差也能使输出无法被使用.

blocks.en:
Contract studies structured legal clause extraction , where the model must identify the requested clause(s) from contracts curated from SEC EDGAR filings and place them into a JSON-style structured output format. Literature asks for scientific evidence extraction , requiring the model to return verbatim supporting spans from full-text articles collected from PubMed Central, including experimental settings, subject or sample descriptions, and statistical analysis statements. Code focuses on code explanation , where the model must briefly explain a target snippet and then reproduce it exactly, using contexts drawn from widely used open-source Python repositories.
To further evaluate exact-copy reliability under stress, we additionally include Random Sequence , where the model must precisely copy synthetic OpenSSH-style key sequences from the input, reflecting cases where encoded configuration values or credential-like identifiers must be copied exactly.
Full benchmark construction details, data sources, and dataset statistics are provided in Appendix E .

为了在压力下进一步评价准确的复制可靠性,我们还加入了"随机序列"(Random Sequence),其中模型必须精确地从输入中复制合成的OpenSSH风格的密钥序列,反映编码的配置值或类似证书的标识符必须准确复制的情况.

Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate both correctness and efficiency. For correctness, we use Exact Match (EM), which requires the generated output to match the target span exactly.
For efficiency, we report decoding throughput in tokens per second (Tokens/s), and summarize relative speedup.

Implementation Details. For SFT baselines, we use LoRA with rank 16.
For CopyGen, we freeze the backbone LM and train only the lightweight plugin (CopyGen SFT {}_{\text{SFT}} applies the plugin on top of the SFT backbone).
For all trainable components, we use dropout 0.05 and gradient accumulation 16.
Optimization uses AdamW [ 16 ] with a cosine learning-rate schedule.
All experiments are run in BF16 precision on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU.
To ensure reproducibility and make decoding behavior comparable across methods, we use deterministic decoding with temperature set to 0 in all experiments; for CopyGen, proposal verification uses the positive-margin threshold γ = 0 \gamma=0 .
Detailed hyperparameters and prompt templates are provided in Appendices G and J , respectively.

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports exact-match accuracy and decoding throughput across four benchmark domains and three backbone LLMs, and Figure 3 visualizes throughput gains on the three real-world tasks. (1) CopyGen substantially improves exact-copy fidelity and decoding efficiency for frozen LLMs. Averaged over the three frozen backbones, CopyGen raises EM from 51.9 51.9 to 70.3 70.3 while increasing throughput from 59.3 59.3 to 901.0 901.0 tokens/s, corresponding to roughly a 15.2 × 15.2\times speedup.
The gains are especially strong on Literature and Random Sequence , where long-span exact reproduction is most brittle under standard decoding.
For example, the average EM improves from 60.3 60.3 to 77.0 77.0 on Qwen3-8B and from 49.9 49.9 to 76.9 76.9 on Ministral-8B, showing that CopyGen strengthens exact copying without updating base model parameters. (2) CopyGen remains highly effective when combined with supervised finetuning. With SFT, CopyGen further improves the average EM from 91.3 91.3 to 95.2 95.2 , while increasing throughput from 45.7 45.7 to 665.0 665.0 tokens/s, a 14.6 × 14.6\times speedup.
These results show that decoding-time copy control and parameter-efficient adaptation are complementary: finetuning improves the model’s overall task performance, while CopyGen further strengthens exact reproduction and substantially accelerates generation.
As shown in Figure 3 , these speedups are consistent across real-world domains, reaching over 12 × 12\times in the base model setting and over 10 × 10\times in the SFT setting.

表1报告四个基准领域和三个主干有限责任公司的确切匹配准确度和编码吞吐量,图3可视化三个现实世界任务的吞吐量收益。 (1) CopyGen大大提高了被冻结的有限责任公司准确复制的忠诚度和解码效率。 CopyGen平均将EM从51.9 51.9升至70.3 70.3,同时将吞吐量从59.3 59.3升至901.0 901.0令牌/秒,大致相当于15.2×15.2\时的速度。
在文学和随机序列上收益特别高,
例如,平均EM在Quen3-8B上从60.3 60.3升至77.0 77.0;在Ministrale-8B上从49.9 49.9升至76.9 76.9,显示CopyGen加强精确复制而不更新基准模型参数. (2) CopyGen在与有监督地微调结合时仍然非常有效. 随着SFT, CopyGen 的进一步改善 平均EM从91.3 91.3到95.2 95.2,同时将吞吐量从45.7 45.7升至665.0 665.0令牌/秒,速度为14.6×14.6\时.
这些结果表明,解码时间复制控制与参数高效的适应是互补的:微调改善了模型的整体任务性能,而CopyGen则会进一步加强精确复制并大大地加速生成.
如图3所示,这些速度在现实世界范围内是一致的,在基准模型设置中达到12×12分,在SFT设置中达到10×10分。

blocks.zh: 图3:现实世界任务的吞吐速度。

blocks.en:
(3) The largest gains appear precisely on tasks where exact boundary and character-level fidelity matter most. On Contract , Literature , and Random Sequence , even small local mistakes in punctuation, clause boundaries, or long low-redundancy strings invalidate the output, and CopyGen yields the largest EM improvements.
On Code , the EM gains are more moderate but still consistent, while throughput improves substantially across all models.
This pattern indicates that CopyGen is effective at stabilizing long source-grounded spans and turning many fragile token-level decisions into fewer verified span emissions. (4) CopyGen is the only method that improves both accuracy and efficiency over source-reuse and constrained-decoding baselines. As shown in Table 2 , lossless acceleration methods such as LLMA and CopySpec leave EM at the base-model level, whereas CopyGen improves average EM by 18.44 points while running 3.19 × 3.19\times and 4.69 × 4.69\times faster than them.
Rule-based constraints and CopySpan all fall below the base model on average, since they cannot reliably determine where the requested span should start and stop in the source document, and the PICARD-style decoder even fails entirely on Contract , where copied clauses must be embedded in JSON strings. (5) Exact copying remains challenging even for frontier LLMs. Even the strongest frontier LLM, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, reaches only 56.03 EM on Contract (Table 16 ). With CopyGen, Qwen3-8B and Ministral-8B already surpass GPT-4.1-nano and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite without finetuning, and all three backbones outperform every frontier LLM when further combined with SFT.
blocks.zh:
(3) 最大的收益恰恰出现在准确的界限和性格忠诚度最重要的任务上。 在 Contract, Lities, and Random Sequence 上,甚至连本地在标出小错误,条款边界,或者长时间的低冗余字符串都会使输出无效, CopyGen 输出最大的EM改进.
在代码方面,EM的增益比较平和,但仍然一致,同时所有模型的吞吐量都大有改善。
这种模式表明,CopyGen能够有效地稳定长期源底跨度,并将许多脆弱的象征性决定转化为经核实的跨度排放量较少。 (4) CopyGen是提高源再用和受限解码基线的准确性和效率的唯一方法. 如表2所示,LLMA和CopySpec等无损失加速方法使EM处于基模水平,而CopyGen在运行3.19×3.19\时间和4.69×4.69\时间时,平均EM提高了18.44分.
基于规则的限制和CopySpan均平均低于基准模型,因为它们无法可靠地确定请求的跨度应在源文档中从何处起止,而PICARD式的解码器甚至完全在合同上失效,其中所复制的条款必须嵌入JSON字符串. (5) 即使对边境有限责任公司来说,准确复制仍然具有挑战性。 即使最强的LLM,DeepSeek-V4-Pro,在合同中也只达到56.03EM(表16)。 由于CopyGen,Qwen3-8B和Ministal-8B已经超越了GPT-4.1-nano和双子座-2.5-Flash-Lite,没有微调,所有三个骨干在与SFT进一步结合时都超过了每一个边疆LLM.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 分析和讨论

blocks.en: 5.1 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.1 读取研究

blocks.en:
We also conduct an ablation study to examine the contribution of each key component in CopyGen, as shown in Tables 3 and 17 .
For w/o Length Proposal , we replace the predicted tentative span length with a fixed copy length k ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 } k\in\{8,16,32,64,128,256\} and average results across the sweep.
The throughput drop is the most pronounced, confirming that no single fixed value can consistently balance boundary precision and long-span efficiency across tasks. Shorter fixed lengths tend to be conservative and avoid over-copy, but they require more copy rounds and limit throughput gains, while longer ones improve speed at the cost of crossing copy boundaries more frequently.
blocks.zh:
我们还进行了一次研究,以审查CopyGen中每个关键组成部分的贡献,见表3和17。
就长度提案而言,我们用固定拷贝长度k {8、16、32、64、128、256}}k\in=8、16、32、64、128、256}和整个扫描的平均结果来取代暂定长度。
吞吐量的下降最为明显,证实没有一个单一的固定值能够一致地平衡跨任务的边界精度和长宽效率. 更短的固定长度往往比较保守并避免多发,但它们需要更多的复制回合并限制吞吐量收益,而更长的固定长度则会提高速度,从而更频繁地跨越复制边界.

blocks.en: Table 3: Average ablation results of CopyGen across the four benchmark domains. Best results are shown in bold .
blocks.zh: 表3:CopyGen在四个基准领域的平均缩减结果。 最佳结果用黑体表示。

blocks.en:
When all replayed positions are assigned equal training weight ( w/o Adaptive Weighting ), both exact match and throughput fall clearly, as learning becomes dominated by easy in-span copy tokens rather than the ambiguous near-boundary cases where copy failures actually occur.
The steepest degradation comes from removing margin calibration ( w/o Margin Calibration ), which effectively reduces CopyGen to copying only when the base model already favors the source token.
In this case, the verifier can neither rescue under-ranked in-span tokens nor suppress marginal continuations near the true boundary, leaving the most error-prone decoding decisions unguarded and entirely to the frozen base model.
Overall, length proposal drives efficiency, adaptive weighting focuses learning where it matters, and margin calibration is what ultimately turns that supervision into reliable exact-copy control.
blocks.zh:
当所有重播位置都被分配到同等的训练分量(w/o adaptive Wighting )时,精确的匹配量和吞吐量都明显下降,因为学习变得以简单的平面复制符为主,而不是实际发生复制故障的模糊的近边界案例.
最陡峭的降解来自去除比值校正(w/o Margin Calcibleation ),它实际上将CopyGen降低到只当基础模型已经偏向源符时才复制.
在这种情况下,核查者既不能抢救排名不足的活塞活塞,也不能压制靠近正边界的边际续作,使得最容易出错的解码决定得不到保护,完全由被冻结的基模型决定.
总体而言,长度建议推动效率,适应性权重侧重于了解其重要性所在,而差分校正是最终将监督转化为可靠的准确拷贝控制。

blocks.en: 5.2 Copy Dynamics and Calibration
blocks.zh: 5.2 复制动态和校正

blocks.en: Figure 4: Copy proposal dynamics and calibration behavior. (a) Proposed copy spans are often longer than the spans finally accepted by the verifier. (b) Token acceptance remains high for medium-length proposals but drops for very long proposals, indicating conservative truncation near uncertain boundaries. (c) Calibration bias suppresses boundary overruns while boosting internally fragile copy positions, helping preserve exact in-span reproduction. Results shown for Qwen3-8B.
blocks.zh: 图4:复制建议书动态和校正行为. (a) 拟议复制期往往长于核查人最后接受的复制期。 (b) 中长提案的接受率仍然很高,但非常长的提案的接受率下降,这表明在不确定边界附近出现了保守的短跑。 (c) 校准偏差抑制了边界被突破,同时提升内部脆弱的复制位置,有助于保持准确的平面复制。 Qwen3-8B显示的结果.

blocks.en:
We analyze the copy behavior of CopyGen to understand whether it simply copies longer spans or learns to control when copying should stop.
Using the literature domain as an example, Figure 4 (a) shows that CopyGen follows a propose-then-verify pattern: the median proposed length is 197 tokens, whereas the median accepted length is 140 tokens.
This gap shows that CopyGen often proposes broad source continuations and lets the verifier trim them before emission.
The results grouped by proposal length further reveal where this strategy is most useful.
As shown in Figure 4 (b), copy-step count rises from short to medium-length proposals and then drops for very long proposals, suggesting that most effective copy events occur at moderate span lengths.
At the same time, token acceptance remains high for medium-length proposals but becomes more conservative for very long ones, indicating that verification mainly intervenes when boundary uncertainty increases.
The same proposal-and-acceptance trends are observed across other tasks and backbones, with full results provided in Appendix H.4 .
Finally, the calibration analysis in Figure 4 (c) provides token-level evidence for this control mechanism.
Confident in-span tokens receive little shift, preserving the base model’s decisions.
Boundary overrun tokens are pushed downward to prevent over-copying, while internally fragile positions receive positive bias to keep generation aligned with the source.
blocks.zh:
我们分析CopyGen的复制行为,以了解它是否只是复制时间更长,或者学会控制何时应该停止复制.
以文献领域为例,图4(a)显示CopyGen遵循了一种提议时的验证模式:建议的中位长度为197个符,而接受的中位长度为140个符.
这一差距表明CopyGen常常提出广泛的源续作,让核查者在排放前对其进行修饰.
按提议长度分类的结果进一步揭示了这一战略在哪些方面最有用。
如图4(b)所显示的,复制步骤的计数从短到中长,然后减少非常长的提案,这表明最有效的复制事件发生在中长。
同时,对中等长度提案的象征性接受仍然很高,但对非常长的提案则变得更加保守,这表明核查主要在边界不确定性增加时进行干预。
在其他任务和支柱中也观察到同样的提议和接受趋势,附录H.4提供了全部结果。
最后,图4(c)中的校正分析为这种控制机制提供了象征性的证据。
自信的活字符号几乎没有变化,
边界超支标志被推向下,以防止复制过多,而内部脆弱位置则得到正面偏好,使生成与来源保持一致。

blocks.en: This analysis suggests that CopyGen improves exact copying not by blindly copying more, but by combining broad span proposals with boundary-aware verification and local calibration.
blocks.zh: 这一分析表明,CopyGen改进了准确的复制,不是盲目复制更多,而是将广泛的提案与了解边界的核查和当地校准相结合。

blocks.en: 5.3 Integration with Inference Engines
blocks.zh: 5.3 与推论引擎结合

blocks.en: Table 4: CopyGen on Qwen3-8B under standard decoding and inference engines, averaged over four domains (full results in Table 13 ). Relative EM changes are computed against the base model; speedup is the mean of per-domain speedups.
blocks.zh: 表4:标准解码和推论引擎下Quen3-8B上的CopyGen,平均超过四个领域(全部结果见表13)。 相对的EM变化根据基模型计算;速度是每个域速度的平均值.

blocks.en:
In real-world deployment, LLMs are typically served through optimized inference engines, and the practical value of CopyGen ultimately depends on whether its gains carry over to such systems. We therefore integrate CopyGen with Qwen3-8B into vLLM [ 12 ] and SGLang [ 30 ] .
As shown in Table 4 , CopyGen improves EM by about 27% relative in both engines, matching its gain under standard decoding, and raises throughput to over 2,000 tokens/s, corresponding to average speedups of 5.74 × 5.74\times and 5.78 × 5.78\times . These speedups are obtained on top of engines that already apply batching and highly optimized execution, while the plugin heads add less than 2.7 % 2.7\% to wall-clock time, indicating that CopyGen can be readily and seamlessly integrated into existing serving stacks.
blocks.zh:
在现实世界的部署中,LLMs通常通过优化的推论引擎来服务,CopyGen的实用价值最终取决于其收益是否延续到这种系统. 因此,我们把CopyGen和Quen3-8B合并到vLLM [12]和SGLang [30].
如表4所示,CopyGen在两台发动机中使EM相对提高了约27%,与其在标准解码下的收益相匹配,使吞吐量提升至2000多个令牌/秒,相当于平均速度为 5.74× 5.74\时和 5.78× 5.78\时. 这些快取是在已经应用了分批和高度优化执行的引擎上方得到的,而插件头将壁点时间加到不到2.7% 2.7+%,表明CopyGen可以随时无缝地被整合到现有的服务堆.

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训效率分析

blocks.en:
Beyond improving decoding efficiency at inference time, CopyGen is also lightweight to train.
Table 5 summarizes the training resources required by SFT and CopyGen across the three backbone models, with full statistics in Table 18 .
Since CopyGen freezes the base LM and trains only small plugin heads, it substantially reduces peak GPU memory relative to LoRA SFT across all backbones, making copy-specific adaptation practical even under tight hardware budgets.
Despite the lower memory usage, training time per example remains broadly comparable to SFT, with marginal improvements in several settings.
Notably, these efficiency and accuracy gains come without touching the base model parameters, making CopyGen a low-overhead, plug-and-play addition to existing LLMs.
blocks.zh:
除了在推断时间提高解码效率外,CopyGen还具有轻量级训练能力.
表5汇总了SFT和CopyGen在三个主干模型中所需的培训资源,表18提供了全部统计数据。
由于CopyGen冻结了基础LM并只列了小插件头,它大大地降低了GPU相对于LORA SFT的峰值内存,跨越了所有主干线,即使在紧凑的硬件预算下,也使得特制拷贝的适应实用.
尽管内存使用率较低,但每个实例的培训时间仍然大致可以与SFT相媲美,有几个环境略有改进.
值得注意的是,这些效率和准确性提高没有触及基准模型参数,使CopyGen成为现有LLMs的低管理头,插头和游戏外加.

blocks.zh: 图5:校准解码痕量案例研究。

blocks.en: 5.5 Case Study
blocks.zh: 5.5 个案研究

blocks.en:
To intuitively understand how CopyGen intervenes at the token level, we randomly select two concrete decoding failures and trace what calibration does to fix them.
In the first example, the model is copying a random key sequence and stumbles on a single character.
The base model produces ...Gcw71Ho3 Ipv J0xOMk... , swapping the capital P for a lowercase p mid-span. This is not a boundary error: the model is well inside an active copy region, and every surrounding token is decoded correctly. The top panel of Figure 5 shows why it happens: the raw verifier margin for IPv dips just below zero at that position, and the base model tips toward the wrong token. Calibration pushes the margin back above the threshold, and CopyGen emits the correct ...Gcw71Ho3 IPv J0xOMk... without interruption.
The second example is a different kind of failure.
Asked to extract the full transfection procedure from a scientific article, the base model stops prematurely after the first sentence, treating the period in “…manufacturer instructions (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA).” as a natural endpoint.
The bottom panel shows the raw margin turning negative at Control , the token that should begin the next sentence.
The base model reads this dip as a stopping cue, but CopyGen recognizes it as a fragile transition rather than a true boundary and lifts the margin above zero, allowing decoding to continue into “Control cells were transfected with empty vector.”
blocks.zh:
要直观地理解 CopyGen 如何在符号层面干预, 我们随机地选择两个 混凝土解码故障, 并跟踪校正如何修复它们。
在第一个例子中,模型是复制一个随机键序列并绊倒在单个字符上.
基本型号生产出. Gcw71Ho3 Ipv J0xOMk. 将资本P换成小写p中宽. 这不是一个边界错误:模型在活动复制区域内,每个周围的符都正确解码. 图5的顶部面板显示它为什么会发生: IPv 的原始校验比值在该位置仅低于零, 而基模型提示错误的符号。 校正将边距推回阈值以上, CopyGen 发出正确的... Gcw71Ho3 IPv J0xOMk... 不中断.
第二例为一相相出相出相.
由于被要求从科学文章中提取出完整的分泌程序,基模在第一句后过早地停止了,将".制造者指令(Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA)"中的分期作为自然终点.
下方面板显示在 Control 时的原始比值变为负值,该符号应该从下句开始 。
基准模型将这种比分读取为停止提示,但CopyGen认识到这是一种脆弱的过渡,而不是一个真正的边界,并将比值提升到0以上,从而允许解码继续进入“控制细胞被空向量传染”。 “

blocks.en:
The two cases capture opposite failure modes, one where the model loses track mid-span, and one where it gives up too early.
Calibrated verification addresses both by learning to distinguish boundaries from low-confidence positions, rather than deferring to the base model’s preference.
blocks.zh:
两个案例捕捉出相反的失败模式,一个模型丢失了跟踪中流线,另一个则过早放弃.
校准的核查通过学习区分界限和低信心立场来解决,而不是服从基准模式的偏好。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we study exact long-span reproduction as a distinct and practically important capability of large language models.
Even when the target span is explicitly present in the input, standard decoding often fails to reproduce it faithfully, especially inside copied spans and near their boundaries.
We introduce a benchmark for exact copying to make this problem concrete, and find current LLMs fall short in reproducing text exactly.
To address this problem, we propose CopyGen, a copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that decomposes exact copying into triggering, tentative span proposal, and token-level verification.
By calibrating source-continuation tokens during verification, experimental results show CopyGen improves both exact-match accuracy and decoding efficiency across models and tasks, suggesting that reliable exact copying is not a trivial consequence of next-token prediction, but a decoding-time control problem that deserves explicit modeling.
We hope this work encourages further research on reliable text generation with LLMs.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们研究了精确的长相复制作为大型语言模型的一种独特而实际重要的能力.
即使输入中明确存在目标跨度,标准解码也往往不能忠实地复制,特别是在被复制的跨度内部和其边界附近.
我们采用了精确复制的基准,使这一问题变得具体化,并且发现目前的有限责任公司在准确复制文本方面还不足。
为了解决这个问题,我们提议CopyGen,一个对被冻结的LLMs进行拷贝限制的插件,它将精确地复制成触发、暂定跨度建议和象征性的核实。
通过校正验证过程中的源连续符,实验结果显示CopyGen在模型和任务上既提高了精确匹配的精度,又提高了解码效率,说明可靠的准确复制并不是下手预测的微不足道的结果,而是一个解码时间控制问题,值得明确的建模.
我们希望这项工作鼓励进一步研究与LLMs的可靠文本生成。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: This study has several limitations.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性。

blocks.en: First, our benchmark focuses on exact span reproduction, and therefore primarily captures boundary fidelity and character-level correctness rather than broader forms of faithful generation such as paraphrasing or abstraction. We believe that treating character-level exact copying as a standalone evaluation dimension is worthwhile in its own right. In many practical applications, semantic approximation is simply not enough, and this capability has long lacked dedicated attention in the literature, making our work a meaningful step toward filling that gap.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们的基准侧重于精确的跨度再生,因此主要捕捉到边界忠诚度和性格水平的正确性,而不是广义的忠实一代形式,如抛写或抽象. 我们认为,将品行一级的准确复制作为独立的评价层面本身就值得。 在许多实际应用中,语义近似是完全不够的,这种能力长期以来在文献中缺乏专注的注意,使我们的工作成为了填补这一空白的有意义的一步.

blocks.en: Second, although we include realistic domains such as contracts, scientific literature, and code, the current benchmark still covers only a limited range of exact-copy scenarios and does not consider settings such as noisy documents, OCR errors, or multilingual copying. We hope the three domains we selected serve as a representative starting point that can inform broader benchmark extensions in future work, rather than an attempt to exhaustively cover every possible scenario.
blocks.zh: 第二,虽然我们包括合同、科学文献和代码等现实领域,但目前的基准仍然只涵盖有限的精确复制情况,不考虑诸如吵闹的文件、OCR错误或多语种复制等设置。 我们希望我们选定的三个领域作为一个具有代表性的起点,可以为今后工作中更广泛的基准扩展提供信息,而不是试图详尽地涵盖每一种可能的情况。

blocks.en: Third, our method is a decoding-time plugin for frozen LLMs, and its performance remains to some extent dependent on the underlying base model. This design trade-off is intentional. We aimed for CopyGen to integrate with existing models with minimal intrusiveness, and our experiments show that it consistently delivers meaningful gains even when the base model is already quite capable.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的方法是冷冻LLMs的解码-时间插件,其性能在一定程度上仍然依赖于基础模型. 这种设计权衡是有意的. 我们的目标是让CopyGen与现有的模型结合,尽量少有侵扰性。 我们的实验表明,即使在基础模型已经相当有能力的情况下,它也始终能够产生有意义的收益。

blocks.en: Finally, the efficiency gains of our method depend on both the task and the implementation. When copy proposals are short or frequently rejected, the overhead of verification may reduce the practical speed advantage. In addition, our current engine integration operates outside fused CUDA kernels, so on-the-fly suffix grounding introduces branching overhead in the decoding loop. Although this overhead is already reflected in our reported measurements, kernel-level batched suffix matching could reduce it further and is left for future work. That said, long-span, low-redundancy exact copying is a common and particularly challenging setting in practice, and it is also where CopyGen’s efficiency gains are most pronounced. This suggests a natural alignment between where our method is designed to help and where it delivers the most value.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们方法的效率提高取决于任务和执行。 如果复制提案时间短或经常被否决,核查的间接费用可能降低实际速度优势。 此外,我们目前的引擎集成在被熔化的CUDA内核之外运行,因此在"一飞后缀"地上会引入分机在解码回路中的高通. 虽然这一间接费用已经反映在我们报告的测量中,但内核级分批后缀匹配可以进一步减少,并留待未来工作。 即便如此,长期、低冗余的复制在实践上也是常见且特别有挑战性的,这也是CopyGen效率增益最为突出的地方。 这表明,在我们的方法被设计用来帮助的地方和它能产生最大价值的地方之间,有一种自然的一致。

blocks.en: Appendix B Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录B 更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
Reliable exact span reproduction can have positive impacts in applications where faithful reuse of source text is important. For example, it can help code assistants preserve identifiers, configuration values, and code snippets exactly. It can also support legal and scientific workflows that require verbatim evidence extraction, while reducing errors introduced by paraphrasing or token-level regeneration.
Since CopyGen can emit verified copied spans more efficiently, it may also reduce inference cost for copy-heavy generation tasks.
blocks.zh:
在忠实地再利用源文本十分重要的应用中,可靠的准确的复制可产生积极影响。 例如,它可以帮助代码助手准确地保存标识符,配置值和代码片段. 它还可以支持需要从逐字取出证据的法律和科学工作流程,同时减少通过去化或符号级再生引入的错误.
由于CopyGen可以发出经核实的复制的跨度更有效率,它也可能降低复制重生成任务的推论成本.

blocks.en: At the same time, improving exact copying can introduce risks if used without appropriate safeguards. A system with stronger copying ability may reproduce sensitive strings, private identifiers, copyrighted text, or other protected content when such content appears in the input context. It may also make users overconfident that copied outputs are always appropriate to reuse, even when the source material is confidential, legally restricted, or incorrectly selected. These risks are especially relevant in settings involving credentials, proprietary documents, legal text, or scientific claims.
blocks.zh: 同时,在没有适当保障措施的情况下使用精确复制可能会带来风险。 具有较强复制能力的系统可以复制敏感字符串,私人标识符,有版权的文本,或者在输入语境中出现其他被保护的内容. 这也可能会使用户过度自信地认为所复制的产出总是适合再利用,即使源材料是保密的,在法律上受到限制的,或者选择错误的. 这些风险在涉及证书、专有文件、法律文本或科学主张的情况下尤其相关。

blocks.en: Our work is intended for source-grounded copying where the target content is explicitly provided in the input and the user or application has permission to use it. We do not train models to extract memorized content from parameters, and the random-sequence benchmark uses only synthetic credential-like strings rather than real secrets. In practical deployments, exact-copy mechanisms should be combined with access control, data-permission checks, and safeguards against copying sensitive or restricted content.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作是为了在输入中明确提供目标内容且用户或应用程序有使用许可的情况下,进行源源取出复制. 我们并不训练模型从参数中取出被记住的内容,随机序列基准只使用合成证书式的字符串,而不是真实的秘密. 在实际部署中,准确复制机制应当与访问控制、数据许可检查以及防止复制敏感或受限制内容的保障措施相结合。

blocks.en: Appendix C Algorithm Framework of CopyGen
blocks.zh: 附录 C 算法 复制源框架

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Copy-Constrained Decoding of CopyGen
blocks.zh: 算法 1 复制限制解码 CopyGen

blocks.en:
Algorithm 1 shows the detailed procedure of how CopyGen works.
At each step, the decoder first measures whether the current prefix is sufficiently grounded in the source.
If so, it may enter copy mode, propose a tentative source span, and verify it token by token.
Only the longest verified prefix is emitted.
If no proposal token is accepted, the decoder performs a source-aware fallback generation step by reranking candidate source-follow tokens before emitting one token.
blocks.zh:
算法 1 显示了CopyGen如何工作的详细程序.
在每一个步骤上,解码器首先衡量当前前缀是否在源头上有足够的根基.
如果是的话,它可以进入复制模式,提出一个暂定源间隔,并用符号验证它。
只有最长的已核实前缀被放出 。
如果没有接受任何提议令牌,解码器在释放出一个令牌之前,通过重新排序候选人的源后符牌来进行源后退生成。

blocks.en: Appendix D Further Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录D 分析

blocks.en: D.1 Fixed Copy Length
blocks.zh: D.1 固定复制长度

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of adaptive span proposal, we compare CopyGen with variants that replace the predicted tentative span length by a fixed global copy length k k .
We sweep k ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 } k\in\{8,16,32,64,128,256\} while keeping the remaining decoding and verification procedure unchanged.
Figure 6 shows two complementary views.
The left panel plots the speed–accuracy tradeoff for each task.
Across tasks, CopyGen is consistently close to the best fixed-length tradeoffs: it preserves the accuracy of shorter fixed lengths while achieving throughput closer to longer fixed lengths.
The right panel shows the fixed-length sweep directly as a function of k k .
The results show that no single fixed length is consistently best across tasks and models.
Smaller values of k k are conservative and help avoid over-copy, but they require more copy rounds and provide limited throughput gains.
Larger values of k k increase throughput, but they are more likely to cross the correct copy boundary and can reduce exact match.
CopyGen avoids this global tuning problem by predicting a tentative length from the current decoding state and leaving the final boundary decision to verification.
This adaptive proposal lets CopyGen achieve a stronger speed–accuracy tradeoff than choosing a single fixed copy length.

blocks.en: D.2 Domain Generalization
blocks.zh: D.2 领域概述

blocks.en:
We further evaluate whether CopyGen generalizes across real-world domains using a leave-one-domain-out setup on Qwen3-8B and Ministral-8B.
For each target domain, CopyGen is trained on the other two real-world domains and evaluated directly on the held-out one.
As shown in Table 6 , the held-out-domain variant performs better than the base model overall, while trailing the corresponding in-domain CopyGen result.
This indicates that CopyGen has nontrivial cross-domain generalization ability: the learned verifier transfers to unseen real-world domains and still delivers clear gains over the base model, although in-domain data remains helpful for best performance.

这表明CopyGen具有非三角跨域通览能力:所学的核查器向看不见的现实世界域转移,并且仍然比基准模型带来明显的收益,尽管域内数据仍然有助于最佳业绩.

blocks.en: D.3 Data Efficiency
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 数据效率

blocks.en:
To examine whether CopyGen remains effective under limited training data, we vary the amount of plugin training data on Qwen3-8B in the frozen-model setting, using 50% and 10% of the full training set. Table 7 shows that CopyGen remains clearly better than the base model even under substantially reduced supervision.
Using only 10% of the training data still yields clear gains on all four domains, while 50% is already sufficient to recover most of the full-data performance and even surpass it in some cases.
These results show that CopyGen remains effective with relatively limited training data, while additional supervision is most helpful on the more challenging settings.

blocks.en: We examine whether the gains of CopyGen depend on the evaluation template or the decoding strategy. All experiments in this subsection use Qwen3-8B and reuse the trained checkpoint of each domain without retraining.

blocks.en: Distribution distortion at and after copy exit. We further check whether the calibration head distorts the sampling distribution around the copy boundary. We teacher-force each example to the end of its gold answer so that the base model and CopyGen reach an identical state, and compare their next-token distributions under both samplers. As shown in Table 11 , the distributions are nearly identical, with a mean total variation below 0.002 0.002 and no top-1 flips. blocks.en: We integrate CopyGen with Qwen3-8B into vLLM v0.25.1 [ 12 ] and SGLang v0.5.15.post1 [ 30 ] . In vLLM, the engine executes the target model while the control logic of CopyGen runs outside it. In SGLang, CopyGen is registered as a custom SpeculativeAlgorithm inside the native speculative scheduler, so that no client-side re-prefill is needed. All measurements use batch size 8 on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, and Table 13 reports per-domain results. To bound the cost of the plugin heads, we run each example twice on an identical token trajectory, once normally and once with all three heads forced on every decoding step. The difference accounts for at most 1.746% of wall-clock time in vLLM and 2.696% in SGLang, since the speedup of CopyGen comes from reducing the number of decoding steps rather than making each step faster.

blocks.en:
We construct four benchmark domains to evaluate exact span reproduction under realistic conditions.
Together, they cover settings where even small deviations in copied text can make the output unusable: legal clauses whose wording and numbering must remain intact, scientific evidence that must be quoted verbatim, code spans whose formatting and symbols are execution-critical, and low-redundancy strings that cannot be recovered from semantics alone.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了四个基准域,以评估在现实条件下准确的复制范围。
它们共同涵盖了即使复制文本中小幅偏差也能使输出无法使用的各种环境:必须保持措辞和编号不变的法律条款、必须逐字引用的科学证据、格式和符号对执行至关重要的代码和无法单独从语义中恢复的低冗余字符串。

blocks.en:
In the contract domain, we focus on structured legal clause extraction .
We collected 2,662 exhibit files from SEC EDGAR filings 1 1 1 https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/ and extracted text from 2,468 of them.
Given a local contract window, the model extracts requested clauses and returns them in a JSON-style object.
The output must preserve the original legal text exactly, including clause headings, numbering, and enumerated subclauses.
This reflects legal drafting and review workflows where downstream systems need exact clause text rather than paraphrased summaries.
blocks.zh:
在合同领域,我们侧重于结构性的法律条款提炼。
我们从SEC EDGAR的档案中收集了2 662个展出文件,其中1 1 https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/从其中的2 468个中提取出文本。
鉴于本地的合同窗口,模型取出所请求的条款并用JSON风格的对象返回.
产出必须准确保留原始法律文本,包括条款标题、编号和列举的子语句。
这反映了下游系统需要确切条款文本而不是被译出摘要的法律起草和审查工作流程。

blocks.en:
In the literature domain, we focus on scientific evidence extraction .
We curated 868 full-text articles from PubMed Central (PMC) 2 2 2 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ , covering 13,206 article sections.
Given a local article context, the model returns the exact evidence span for a requested scientific detail, such as an experimental protocol, sample description, assay procedure, or statistical analysis statement.
This reflects scientific search and review workflows where users need faithful quotations from the original paper, since small wording changes can distort methodological or empirical claims.
blocks.zh:
在文献领域,我们注重科学证据的取出。
我们整理了来自PubMed Central(PMC)的868篇全文文章 2 2 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/,涵盖13,206篇文章部分.
鉴于当地的文章背景,模型返回所要求的科学细节的确切证据跨度,例如实验协议、样本描述、化验程序或统计分析说明。
这反映了科学搜索和审查工作流程,用户需要从原始文件中忠实地取出引文,因为小的措辞变化可能扭曲方法或经验性的说法。

blocks.en:
In the code domain, we focus on code explanation , using several well-known open-source Python web and API repositories, including FastAPI , SQLModel , and Starlette , whose APIs and test code is realistic and standard, allowing us to focus on faithful reproduction rather than deep program reasoning.
Together, these repositories contain over 1,500 Python files, more than 130K non-blank lines of Python code, and 766 test files.
Given a local code context, the model briefly explains a target snippet and then reproduces it exactly.
The task emphasizes faithful reproduction rather than deep program reasoning, since many target snippets contain fragile structures such as nested dictionaries, string literals, and brackets.
blocks.zh:
在代码域中,我们专注于代码解释,使用几个知名的开源Python网络和API寄存器,包括FastAPI,SQLModel,和Starlette ,其API和测试代码是现实而标准的,使我们能够专注于忠实的再生而不是深度的程序推理.
这些寄存器总共包含超过1500个Python文件,超过130K个非空行的Python代码,以及766个测试文件.
鉴于本地代码的背景,该模型简要地解释了一个目标片段,然后准确地复制.
任务强调忠实的再生而非深层的程序推理,因为许多目标片段包含有被嵌入的词典,字符串文字,和括号等脆弱的结构.

blocks.en:
We additionally include an exact long-string reproduction task to isolate faithful copy when the target has little semantic redundancy.
Specifically, we generate realistic OpenSSH-style private-key files and ask the model to reproduce the key sequence exactly.
All values are generated for this study and do not correspond to real credentials.
The target strings are long, low-redundancy sequences containing line breaks, mixed-case letters, digits, and symbols such as / and + , reflecting software and infrastructure workflows where encoded configuration values, serialized artifacts, or credential-like identifiers must be copied exactly.
blocks.zh:
另外,我们还包括一个精确的长弦复制任务,当目标没有多少语义冗余时,隔离忠实的复制.
具体来说,我们生成现实的OpenSSH风格的私钥文件,并要求模型精确地复制密钥序列.
所有数值都为本研究生成,与真实的资质不符.
目标字符串是长而低的冗余序列,包含行间断,混入式字母,数字等符号,并如 /和 +等,反映软件和基础设施工作流程,其中编码配置值,序列化文物,或类似证书的标识符必须准确复制.

Copy supervision is activated only when the current prefix has sufficient source grounding, using τ = 5 \tau=5 , and the length objective is applied to the tentative span prediction.

At inference time, CopyGen uses deterministic decoding with temperature set to 0 0 .
Proposal verification uses a verifier threshold of γ = 0 \gamma=0 , and when no proposal is accepted, decoding falls back to a source-aware one-step generation rule.

Theory assumptions and proofs Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof? Answer: [N/A] Justification: This paper does not include theoretical results or formal proofs. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced. • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems. • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition. • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material. • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced. 4. Experimental result reproducibility Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Sections 3 – 4 and appendix G provide the method, benchmark construction, implementation details, and evaluation setup needed to reproduce the main results. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not. • If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable. • Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed. • While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results. 5. Open access to data and code Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material? Answer: [Yes] Justification: We provide a github repository with code, benchmark artifacts, and instructions for reproducing the main experiments, and include it as supplementary material at submission time. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code. • Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details. • While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark). • The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details. • The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc. • The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why. • At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable). • Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted. 6. Experimental setting/details Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Section 4 and Appendix E provide the data splits, model settings, hyperparameters, optimizer, and decoding details. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them. • The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material. 7. Experiment statistical significance Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments? Answer: [Yes] Justification: All reported significance results are based on a two-tailed paired test with p < 0.05 p<0.05 . Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper. • The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions). • The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.) • The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors). • It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean. • It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified. • For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates). • If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text. 8. Experiments compute resources Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Section 4 and Appendix H.5 report the GPU type, memory usage, and training-time statistics. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage. • The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute. • The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper). 9. Code of ethics Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The research uses public or synthetic data and follows the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. • If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics. • The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction). 10. Broader impacts Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Appendix B discusses both beneficial uses and potential risks of exact copying. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed. • If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact. • Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations. • The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster. • The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology. • If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML). 11. Safeguards Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The random-sequence data in our work uses synthetic credential-like strings rather than real secrets. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks. • Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters. • Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images. • We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort. 12. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Appendix I documents the external assets and their licenses or terms of use. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset. • For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided. • If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators. 13. New assets Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Appendix E documents the benchmark construction, data sources, and dataset statistics. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets. • Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc. • The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used. • At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file. 14. Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)? Answer: [N/A] Justification: This paper does not involve crowdsourcing or research with human subjects. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper. • According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector. 15. Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained? Answer: [N/A] Justification: This paper does not involve human-subject research so IRB approval is not applicable. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper. • We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution. • For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review. 16. Declaration of LLM usage Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required. Answer: [N/A] Justification: LLM is only used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components. • Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 索赔问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了该文件的贡献和范围? 答复:[是] 说明: 摘要和导言总结了我们工作的主要主张和范围,第4节的经验结果证实了这些主张。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指抽象和导言不包括文件中提出的要求。 抽象和/或导言应明确说明所提出的主张,包括文件中的贡献以及重要的假设和限制。 [否]或[否/A]对这个问题的答复不会为审议者所看好。 所提出的索赔应当与理论和实验结果相匹配,并反映在多大程度上可以期望将结果归纳到其他环境中。 只要文件明确没有实现这些目标,就最好将理想目标作为动力列入。 2. 限制问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制? 答复:[是] 理由说明:附录 A讨论了我们工作的主要局限。 • 答案[N/A]是指文件没有限制,而答案[否]是指文件有限制,但在文件中没有讨论。 鼓励作者在论文中另设"限制"一栏. 文件应该指出任何强有力的假设,以及这些假设被违反的结果如何有力(例如,独立性假设、无噪声设置、模型精确度、不对称近似只在当地持有)。 作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反,其影响如何。 作者应反思所提出主张的范围,例如,如果该办法只在几个数据集或几个运行中测试。 一般来说,经验性结果往往取决于隐含的假设,应当加以阐述。 作者应思考影响该方法执行的因素。 例如,一面相识别算法在图像分辨率低或图像取自于低照明时可能表现不佳. 或语音到文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供闭门字幕,因为它无法处理技术术语。 作者应讨论拟议算法的计算效率,以及它们如何用数据集大小进行比例。 如果适用,作者应讨论他们处理隐私和公平问题的方法可能存在的局限性。 虽然作者可能担心审查人员会把完全诚实的局限性作为拒绝的理由,但更糟糕的结果可能是审查人员发现文件中没有承认的局限性。 作者应运用最佳判断,并承认有利于透明度的个别行动在制定维护社会完整性的规范方面发挥重要作用。 将特别指示审查人员不要惩罚有关限制的诚实行为。 3. 理论假设和证明 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明? 答复:[不详]理由: 本文件不包括理论结果或正式证明. 指导方针: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括理论结果. 二. 支助 纸上所有定理,公式和证明,都应该编号并相互参照. 二. 支助 · 所有假设都应在任何定理的说明中明确说明或提及。 证据可以出现在正文或补充材料中,但如果在补充材料中出现,则鼓励作者提供简短的证明草图来提供直觉. • 反之,文件核心中提供的任何非正式证据应辅以附录或补充材料中提供的正式证据。 • 应适当参考证据所依据的定理和莱玛。 4. 实验结果可复制 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)? 答复:[是] 说明:第3至4节和附录 G提供复制主要成果所需的方法、基准构建、实施细节和评价设置。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 如果论文包括了实验,审查人员将不会很好地看待对这一问题的回答: 使该文件可以复制很重要,无论是否提供代码和数据。 如果资料是数据集和/或模型,作者应说明为使结果可以复制或核实而采取的步骤。 • 视贡献情况,可采用各种方式实现可复制性。 例如,如果这种贡献是一种新颖的架构,充分描述这种架构可能就足够了,或者如果这种贡献是一种具体的模型和经验性评价,那么就可能有必要使其他人有可能用同样的数据集复制该模型,或者提供对模型的取用. 总论. 释放代码和数据往往是实现这一目的的好办法,但也可以通过详细指示来提供可复制性,说明如何复制结果,访问主机模型(如在大语言模型的情况下),释放模型检查点,或者其他适合进行的研究的手段. 二. 支助 虽然NeurIPS并不要求发布代码,但会议确实要求所有提交文件提供一些合理的可复制途径,这可能取决于贡献的性质. 例如(a) 如果贡献主要是一种新的算法,则论文应当说明如何复制该算法。 (b) 如果贡献主要是新的示范架构,文件应清楚而全面地描述该架构。 (c) 如果贡献是一个新的模型(例如大型语言模型),那么应该有一种方法来访问这个模型来复制结果,或者有一种方法来复制模型(例如,有一个开源数据集或关于如何构建数据集的指示). (d) 我们认识到,在某些情况下,可复制性可能很困难,在这种情况下,欢迎作者说明它们为可复制性规定的具体方式。 就闭源模型而言,可能以某种方式(例如,对已注册的用户)限制对模型的访问,但其他研究者应该有一定途径复制或验证结果. 5. 开放存取数据和代码 如补充材料所描述的那样,该文件是否提供了公开查阅数据和代码的机会,并提供了忠实复制主要实验结果的充分指示? 答复:[是] 说明: 我们提供了一个github存储器,有代码,基准文物,以及复制主要实验的说明,并在提交时将其作为补充材料。 · 答案[N/A]是指纸张不包括需要密码的实验。 详情请见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy)。 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据,但我们理解这也许是不可能的,因此[否]是一个可以接受的答案. 文件不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝,除非这是贡献的核心(例如,对于一个新的开源基准). 二. 支助 指示应包含复制结果所需的准确命令和环境。 详情见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy)。 作者应提供关于数据存取和准备的说明,包括如何取用原始数据、预先处理的数据、中间数据和生成的数据等。 作者应提供脚本来复制所有实验结果,用于新的拟议方法和基线。 如果只有一组实验可以复制,它们应该说明哪些实验从剧本中删除,以及为什么。 在提交来文时,为保持匿名,提交人应公布匿名版本(如果适用的话)。 • 建议在补充材料中提供尽可能多的资料(附于文件),但允许将URL纳入数据和代码。 6. 实验设置/细节问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(例如数据分解、超参数、如何选择、优化者类型等)? 答复:[是] 理由说明:第4节和附录 E提供了数据分解,模型设置,超参数,优化器,并解码细节. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 试验环境应在文件的核心中详细介绍,以便评估结果,使之合理。 详细情况可通过守则、附录或补充材料提供。 7. 实验统计意义 问题: 纸质报告错误是否包含适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息? 答复:[是] 说明: 所有报告的重大结果均以双尾配对试验为基础,试验时间为:p < 0.05 p < 0.05。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 如果结果附有出错栏、置信间隔或统计意义测试,至少对于支持论文主要主张的实验,作者应回答[是]。 应明确说明错误条所捕获的可变因素(例如,列车/测试分拆、初始化、随机绘制某些参数,或在特定实验条件下的总体运行)。 计算出错栏的方法应加以解释(封闭表单公式、调用库函数、靴子等) • 应给出假设(例如,通常分布式错误)。 应明确出错栏是标准偏差还是平均值的标准出错. ^ 报告1-西格玛出错栏是正常的,但应该说明这一点。 撰文者最好报告2-西格玛出错栏,而不是说如果错误的正常性假设没有得到核实,他们有96%的CI。 二. 支助 对于不对称分布,作者应注意不要在表格或数字对称错误栏中显示会产生超出范围的结果(如负出错率). 二. 支助 如果在表格或图中报告出错栏,作者应在正文中解释其计算方式并参考正文中的相应数字或表格. 8. 实验计算资源 问题:对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息? 答复:[是] 说明:第4节和附录H.5报告了GPU类型、内存使用和培训时间统计。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 纸张应说明计算工人的CPU或GPU、内部集群或云提供商的类型,包括相关的内存和存储。 文件应提供每次试验所需的计算数额并估计总计算数。 文件应披露整个研究项目是否比文件所报道的实验需要更多的计算(例如,初步或失败的实验,这些实验没有把它写入文件)。 9. 道德守则问题:文件中进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)? blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper. • The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper. • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be. • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated. • The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon. • The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size. • If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness. • While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not. • If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable. • Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed. • While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
